newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay shares power ahead, Reliance leads.
newsitem.headline: Bombay shares power ahead, Reliance leads.

text.p: ** (0730 GMT) - Bombay blue chips add gains after hesitant
start, Reliance leads rally ahead of bonus announcement
** Market likely to see-saw on Reliance bonus, stock trades
6.0 rupees higher at 372.25, near day's highs
** Bombay share index jumps 41.22 pts, one pct at 4,134.84
** Move by India's central bank on Wednesday to cut
interest rates by one percentage point to 10 percent
** Cosmetics firm Lakme Ltd falls after poor results
** Bank of India, Tata Power, IFCI 1996/97 results due
